items.title: Human Tsunami
items.hook: Guess first. Then watch one full crossing.

question.text: How many people do you predict will cross during one cycle?

items.task: Watch one complete crossing. Compare it with your guess.
items.visualIdea: Aerial Shibuya only after the prediction
items.notes: No correctChoiceId. Do not show the aerial before they guess.

items.title: The Dog Who Kept Coming Back
story: Every day Hachiko met his owner at this station.
One day his owner never came home.
What do you think Hachiko did?
items.reveal: Hachiko kept coming back, for years.
items.notes: Confirm the number of years and the owner’s name before live.
